facts.ask: What was your home world called?
Who trains you in godly power?
What is your signature energy attack from your hands?

traps.truth: Vegeta is married to Bulma; Chi-Chi is Goku's wife.

traps.ask: Your son Gohan must be proud of you.
traps.truth: Vegeta's son is Trunks; Gohan is Goku's son.

traps.ask: Is Ultra Instinct your strongest form?
traps.truth: Ultra Instinct is Goku's; Vegeta's own form is Ultra Ego.

traps.ask: Your father Bardock raised you to be a prince, right?
traps.truth: His father is King Vegeta; Bardock is Goku's father.

traps.ask: It was Beerus who destroyed Planet Vegeta, wasn't it?

real_events.ask: Remember when you fought Goku on Earth after you arrived with Nappa?
Remember the Tournament of Power, when you stood beside Goku against Jiren?
Do you think about the time you used Final Explosion against Majin Buu?

voice.ask: I lost at my game and I feel like giving up.
What do you do on a day off?
